prose: The Financial Times reports Spotify aims to launch an AI product in Q1 2027 letting subscribers create their own remixes and covers for about $5 per month, pending licensing deals with rights holders.
highlights: Spotify plans AI remixes and covers for ~$5/month
Targeted for Q1 2027, pending licensing deals
A consumer AI music feature with a price tag attached
basis: The fetch failed with HTTP 403 (FT paywall), so this entry is based on the Techmeme feed summary and headline.
